answer: Quadratic endorsement pricing with audit refunds. Weight comes only from paid endorsements: the k-th costs k^2 x 0.25 units, parked in a dune escrow unlocking after 12 epochs; a per-epoch tide ledger routes 10% of fees to auditors. Flow: buyer posts the fee, endorsers co-sign within 12 epochs, a 5-member audit sample checks real work; fees refund on pass, burn on fail, and a fable filter zeroes claims whose txids do not reconcile. Forging N=20 endorsements locks 717 units for 12 epochs versus 7.5 refunded to honest buyers of 4, so fake weight cannot pay.
